steps.code:
# Build mapping from song title to release month/year
release_map = {}
for detail in song_details:
    # Extract month/year from release_date like "2022-10-29T01:54:53"
    date_str = detail['release_date']
    # Take first 7 characters: YYYY-MM
    month_year = date_str[:7]  # e.g., "2022-10"
    # Convert to MM/YYYY format
    parts = month_year.split('-')
    mm_yyyy = f"{parts[1]}/{parts[0]}"
    release_map[detail['title']] = mm_yyyy

print(release_map)

        if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
